source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_inventory_non_operational_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'data_flow_task_1_11') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_11_OLEDBSource_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_inventory_non_operational_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'data_flow_task_1_11') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_11_OLEDBSource_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_inventory_non_operational_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'data_flow_task_1_11') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_11_OLEDBSource_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_inventory_non_operational_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'data_flow_task_1_11') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_11_OLEDBDestination_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_inventory_non_operational_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'data_flow_task_1_11') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_11_OLEDBDestination_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_inventory_non_operational_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'data_flow_task_1_11') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_11_OLEDBDestination_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Data_Flow_Task_1_110_sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_inventory_non_operational_data_import') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_110_sink_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Data_Flow_Task_1_110_sink_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_inventory_non_operational_data_import') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_110_sink_TableName;

c.INSTALL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION,   c.MODEL_CATEGORY,   c.DEVICE_SYS_CLASS_NAME,   c.DEVICE_SYS_CLASS_DESC,   c.ENVIRONMENT_DESCRIPTION,   c.IS_VIRTUAL,   c.MANUFACTURER,   c.MODEL_NAME, c.LEVEL_3_REPORT_NAME,   c.LEVEL_4_REPORT_NAME,   c.SOC_INDICATOR,   c.LOCATION_NAME,   c.STREET,   c.CITY,   c.STATE_PROVINCE,   c.COUNTRY,   c.RACK_NAME,   c.RACK_UNIT_LOCATION,   c.CPU_CORE_COUNT,   c.RELATED_PROCESSOR_COUNT,   c.CPU_SPEED_MHZ,   c.CPU_TYPE,   c.RAM,   c.DISK_SPACE,   c.OPERATIONAL_DATE,   c.DOMAIN_NAME,   c.IP_ADDRESS,   c.REL_APPLICATION_DISTRIBUTED_ID,   c.REL_DIRECT_APPLICATION_NAME,   c.REL_INDIRECT_APPLICATION_NAME,   c.SYS_UPDATED_ON,   d.PRIMARY_APP_DISTRIBUTED_ID,   g.hrdwr_suprt,   g.mdlwr_suprt,   g.db_suprt,   g.os_patch_suprt,   g.os_suprt,   g.srvr_bckp_svc_suprt,   c.MODEL_NUMBER,   tsc.wf_guid,    tsc.u_obsolete,   tsc.u_tsc_retirement_date,   tsc.tsc_wf_extended_support_date,    tsc.u_technopedia_product_id,   c.sys_created_on, c.operation_status_description IN ('RETIRED','NON-OPERATIONAL')
